caption: The drawing depicts a quilt pattern composed of nine square blocks arranged in a 3x3 grid. The blocks alternate between those filled with a small-floral print on a cream or light background and patterned star motifs. Three of the blocks contain large, eight-pointed stars, set against a background divided into four triangles; the colors of these stars include combinations of red, brown, blue, black, grey, and white, with various small patterns and checks. One block has a star with irregular points that feature a multicolored paisley and geometric pattern merging red, brown, white, and green hues. The other blocks in the grid show the small floral fabric. The center block is comprised entirely of the floral pattern. The background outside the central quilt grid is plain beige. At the bottom, there is a light pencil or ink drawing showing a grid that corresponds to the quilt design, and a small rectangular label with printed text in the lower left corner.
title: Star Design Comforter
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
